Change c0146. Location: 1818 Vol. I, Ch. VI; 1831 Ch. VII.

Context before (unchanged): I prophesied truly, and failed only in one single circumstance, that in all the misery I imagined and dreaded, I did not conceive the hundredth part of the anguish I was destined to endure.

1818 text: It was completely dark when I arrived in the environs of Geneva; the gates of the town were already shut; and I was obliged to pass the night at Secheron, a village half a league to the east of the city.

1831 text: It was completely dark when I arrived in the environs of Geneva; the gates of the town were already shut; and I was obliged to pass the night at Secheron, a village at the distance of half a league from the city.

Diff: It was completely dark when I arrived in the environs of Geneva; the gates of the town were already shut; and I was obliged to pass the night at Secheron, a village {+at the distance of+} half a league [-to the east of-] {+from+} the city.

Context after (unchanged): The sky was serene; and, as I was unable to rest, I resolved to visit the spot where my poor William had been murdered.

result.rationale: "a village half a league to the east of the city" becomes "a village at the distance of half a league from the city". This is a rephrasing of the same distance; the only loss is the minor compass detail "to the east".
